sources.title: A Lightweight YOLOv8 Model for Apple Leaf Disease Detection
sources.snippet: This study proposes a lightweight algorithm for apple leaf disease detection in natural environments, which is conducive to application on mobile and embedded devices. Our approach modifies the YOLOv8n framework to improve accuracy and efficiency.
